_doc: provenance.py staleness table (Seed B). max_age_hours per source KIND: a fact read from a record older than its kind's limit is STALE and reads as UNKNOWN in the fact gate (shown with its stamp, never asserted). null = durable, never stale (a note, a memory, a config value). An unlisted kind takes default_max_age_hours. DATA, not code: an organization copies this file beside its own binding and tunes it; the engine ships these generic kinds as the template. Values here are the engine defaults; the production organizations' own tables use their system of record's names.
